liquor: INSERT INTO Stock_Items (stock_name, item_type, bottle_count, bottle_size_oz, open_bottle_oz, serving_size) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
employee: INSERT INTO Employees (employee_role, employee_name, passcode) VALUES (%s, %s, %s)
menu_items: INSERT INTO Menu_Items (drink_name, price, drink_type) VALUES (%s, %s, %s)
menu_ingredients: INSERT INTO Menu_Item_Ingredients (menu_id, stock_id) SELECT m.menu_id, s.stock_id FROM Menu_Items m JOIN Stock_Items s ON s.stock_name = %s WHERE m.drink_name = %s
